# PDF.js 6.3.289

`build/pdf.min.mjs` and `build/pdf.worker.min.mjs` are the official **legacy**
compatibility bundles from `pdfjs-dist@6.3.289` on npm (`package/legacy/build`).
Both bundles must come from the same version and build type. They include
polyfills for older browsers, including mobile Safari. Resource directories
and LICENSE come from the same package. No PDF source bytes are changed.
